approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the ACME Bonsai CEO team (Apex)

answer_strategic_question.notes: Strategic questions have no SLA — Jane answers when he has thought it through.

capture_decision.notes: Almanac drafts decision entries; Jane acks within 48h or edits.

record_outcome.notes: When a decision's outcome window opens, Jane records the actual outcome within 7 days.

approve_memo.notes: Memos have no SLA — Jane approves when the wording is right.

approve_external_comm.notes: Per-message approval required for every Envoy outbound. Silence is never consent.

emergency_stop.notes: Emergency stop can be activated immediately by Jane or Apex.
